analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued a notice convening its 34th Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 29, 2026, via video conferencing. The business to be transacted includes considering and adopting the audited standalone and consolidated financial statements for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. The shareholders will also consider resolutions for the re-appointment of directors, including Dr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah as an Independent Director and Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan as a Whole-time Director.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that AI adoption among small businesses is surging, with approximately three-quarters of small firms expected to be AI-powered soon.
demand_outlook.quote: An additional 9% plan to begin using AI within the next year, indicating that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.

margins_costs.claim: The company implemented affordable pricing models, such as a $10 per month entry plan for dRyZe CRM, to remove cost barriers for micro-businesses.
margins_costs.quote: For example, dRyZe CRM’s entry plan was set at just $10 per month for up to 5 users, deliberately removing the price barrier that had long prevented micro-businesses from using sophisticated CRM tools.

orders_capacity.claim: The dSpeedUp platform grew to serve over 1000 merchants with a 95% annual client retention rate.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Management identified that many small enterprises lack the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: These efforts were aimed at closing the “resource and information gap” noted in industry surveys (e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that supports millions of entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
